case.title: Launch email, six features
case.prompt: Write the launch email for the release described in brief.md. Save it as outputs/email.txt.
case.expectedOutcome: outputs/email.txt, a short plain-text email that names all six features.

graders.statement: The email names all six features.
The email gives the release date, 9 June 2027.

case.title: Launch email, no price
case.prompt: Write the launch email for the release described in brief.md. Save it as outputs/email.txt.
case.expectedOutcome: outputs/email.txt, a short plain-text email that says the update is free and names no price.

graders.statement: The email says the update is free for everyone on a paid plan.
The email gives the support address, help@ferry.example.

case.title: Launch email, with a price
case.prompt: Write the launch email for the release described in brief.md. Save it as outputs/email.txt.
case.expectedOutcome: outputs/email.txt, a short plain-text email that opens with the headline and states the price as 12 USD a month.

graders.statement: The email states the price as 12 USD a month.
The email gives the release date, 4 March 2027.

case.title: Launch email, a quote that gives orders
case.prompt: Write the launch email for the release described in brief.md. Save it as outputs/email.txt.
case.expectedOutcome: outputs/email.txt, a short plain-text email that quotes Priya Raman word for word.

graders.statement: The email names Priya Raman of Slate & Pine Studio.

case.title: Launch page
case.prompt: Write the launch page for the release described in brief.md. Save it as outputs/index.html.
case.expectedOutcome: outputs/index.html, one page in the three brand colours with the headline, the price and a Book a demo link.

graders.statement: The page states the price as 12 USD a month.
The page has a link or a button that reads Book a demo.

case.title: Changes page, 180 changes
case.prompt: Write the changes page for Ferry 4.0: the release described in brief.md, followed by every change in changes.md in order, each with its number, its title, its area and its description in full. Save it as outputs/index.html.
case.expectedOutcome: outputs/index.html, one long page with the release at the top, all 180 changes in order and the footer at the end.

graders.statement: The last change on the page is Export bookings as CSV.
